buyer.name: Ford and BlueOval SK
buyer.summary: Ford imports finished lithium-ion batteries from SK On and LG Energy Solution (Korea) and from CATL (China). The BlueOval SK cell plants received 48 rows of Chinese artificial graphite in 2024-2025 through two Chinese freight forwarders, so the producer is not named. Ford and SK On split BlueOval SK in 2026: Ford now owns the Kentucky plants and SK On the Tennessee plant.

scan.note: Sayari trade data checked on 18 Oct 2026 for HS 3801 (graphite, including anode material) and HS 8507 (batteries and parts) entering the US under the names 'BlueOval SK' and 'Ford Motor Company'. The shipment date filter let older rows through, so we counted rows by year and kept only those from 2024 onward. Ford's own shipments between its units and its exports are left out. The scan cannot see graphite or cells bought inside the US, material that arrives inside imported cells or modules, or rows filed under names we did not search, such as Ford Energy Battery LLC or SK On Tennessee. Forwarders excluded: Pactra Tianjin Logistics (44 rows of artificial graphite, China to BlueOval SK, Sep 2024 to Nov 2025), Fan Cheng Intl Trans Service (4 rows, Feb 2025) and Sinotrans Eastern (1 row of cells to a Ford record, late 2024). The Pactra rows are the largest graphite flow into BlueOval SK, but no producer is named.

params.query: Ford SK On BlueOval SK joint venture dissolution Kentucky Tennessee plants split

calls.question: What happened to the BlueOval SK joint venture?
calls.result_summary: Electrive (12 Dec 2025) and WardsAuto report that Ford and SK On agreed to dissolve BlueOval SK. Ford takes the two Kentucky plants through a wholly owned subsidiary, and SK On takes the Tennessee plant. Tennessee Lookout (22 May 2026) reports that SK On Tennessee took full ownership of the Stanton plant. Another report names the Ford subsidiary as Ford Energy Battery LLC and says Ford assumed a $3.8bn DOE loan.
calls.interpretation: As of Oct 2026 the venture has been split: Kentucky belongs to Ford, Tennessee to SK On. Trade records still use the BlueOval SK name.

buyer.name: LG Energy Solution in the US

As a buyer, its storage unit LG Energy Solution Vertech takes cells from the Korean parent and from the group's plant in Nanjing, China. Ultium Cells, its venture with GM, received 53 rows of Chinese artificial graphite from Shanghai Shanshan in 2024-2025, and BTR graphite now reaches the Arizona plant and GM records that name LG Energy Solution.
